snippet.title: 33 Immortals - Demo Trailer (ESRB)
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW! 33 Immortals Demo is LIVE on Steam and Epic Games Store. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191960/33_Immortals_Demo/

Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/33-immortals-33-immortals-demo-9d0df9

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul, and rebel against God's final judgment. Pick-up and raid, cooperate to survive hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and face the wrath of God in the ultimate fight for your eternal life.

Are you ready to fight for your eternal life? Play now and join the rebellion! 

Subscribe to our newsletter to stay updated: https://thunderlotusgames.com/33-immortals/#newsletter-sign-up
